Thanks, Gideon. I've noted that Hanne told you Vantorre may cut to 240 seats at the June renewal. I won't repeat it in any channel or in a message to anyone else, including Ruth and Nadia, unless you tell me otherwise and the people in that conversation are already entitled to see it.

If you want Ruth or Nadia to hear it, you could raise it with Hanne first, since it came from her, or with Ruth directly. I can help you work out what to say, but I'll keep that discussion between you and me.
